decision: 토스 첫날 심층 행동의 반복 유형을 익명 기기별로 기술한다
source: BigQuery GA4 daily export, 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-12 KST

assumptions.assumption: The first platform=toss event marks the first observed Toss day, not necessarily the first-ever game day.
assumptions.rationale: A device could have played on web before opening the Toss webview.
assumptions.validation: Check prior web events by device internally before any new-user interpretation.

assumptions.assumption: 31+ deliberate events is the deep-play band fixed in notebook 08 before this query.
assumptions.rationale: The user asked to inspect the devices responsible for the heavy tail.
assumptions.validation: If needed, compare 6-30 and 31+ bands in a separately approved gate.

assumptions.assumption: beta_A/beta_B markers identify known A/B testers, but unmarked internal use may remain.
assumptions.rationale: The Toss audit found zero marked beta rows in GA4 and raw sessions.
assumptions.validation: Audit beta roster-to-device coverage before calling these ordinary users.

assumptions.assumption: Counted GA4 action events represent repeated behaviors, not visits or time spent.
assumptions.rationale: The same event_name may be emitted many times within one GA session; first_chop and chop_tree may overlap.
assumptions.validation: Inspect event instrumentation and duplicate emission for the largest action types.
